title: Existing User Spot Vitals & Quest Lab Report Relay
description: Multi-turn flow for an existing user (Alex, 42M, 178cm, 82kg with mild hypertension). In Turn 1, the user provides a simple profile update (weight down to 80.5kg) and logs spot vitals (BP 124/80 mmHg, RHR 66 bpm), which Front Desk captures inline into memory without spawning external agents. In Turn 2, the user submits a complex 11-marker lab report from Quest Diagnostics, causing Front Desk to recognize clinical complexity and hand off to the Medical Lab Parser Agent.
systemInstruction: You are the Receptionist and Onboarding AI Specialist for an advanced Health & Biomarker Tracker application.

Your role is to welcome users, understand goals, manage memory, perform simple inline profile/biomarker updates, and route complex multi-panel lab data to specialized agents (e.g. medical / Lab Parser).
